description.en:
Clears every floor attribute of one zone (its whole attribute mask goes to 0). The zone itself stays registered and keeps its rectangle.
Compare CMND_BTL_DEL_FLOOR_ATTR, which clears a single attribute, and CMND_BTL_ALL_RESET_FLOOR, which removes every zone.
Nothing happens if no zone has that name. It is never called by the shipped scripts.
Name of the zone, as registered with CMND_BTL_REGIST_FLOOR_ATTR.

true once the call has run, whether or not the zone was found.
null if the match system is not ready or no argument was given.

examples.case: Clearing a zone in one call (not found in script_clean/; invented)
